author: Yggy_
body:
You can get to 160~ fast enough by doing Monuments.

After that u can reach 200~ with world raids. I suggest unlocking Elysian classes (attuner class) by 150lvl and Time Mage specialization for Lacuna spell. Overall will be a slow process but the safest of all.

Around April there will be the House of Fomoria event in which u can acquire Summon Buggane Spell (T8) 

After 200lvl you can start doing Towers, they reward a decent exp as well.

If u have a helpful friend or kingdom mate he can help swipe raids faster but u will need more scrolls that way.
